# Pull Request

## What changed

Describe the bounded change.

## Why

Link the requirement, issue or ADR and explain the user/developer impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting/lint/type checks
- [ ] Unit/integration tests
- [ ] Relevant media golden/evaluation tests
- [ ] Mobile/browser smoke where applicable
- [ ] Security/privacy impact reviewed
- [ ] Documentation updated

List exact commands and results:

## Risks and rollback

Describe failure modes, feature flag/rollback and migrations.

## Remaining work

State anything incomplete, manually required or intentionally deferred.
